name: A Lemonade Stand-up Comedy
description: A Lemonade Stand-up Comedy features stand-up comedy with sharp jokes at Look Sharp Café. The event includes appealing coffee, food, and drinks.
longDescription:
A Lemonade Stand-up Comedy brings stand-up comedy to Look Sharp Café. The show promises sharp jokes, possibly like dessert knives, in an evening of entertainment.

The Look Sharp Café offers coffee, food, and drinks. The event is free to attend and is suitable for ages 12 and up. It takes place on November 4, 2026, starting at 9 PM.

The venue is located at R. de Cimo de Vila 41, 4000-169 Porto. The comedy is performed in English.

longDescriptionPt:

O Look Sharp Café oferece café, comida e bebidas. A entrada no evento é gratuita e é adequado para maiores de 12 anos. Acontece a 4 de novembro de 2026, com início às 21h.

O local fica na R. de Cimo de Vila 41, 4000-169 Porto. A comédia é apresentada em inglês.
